strings.zh: 你别担心！{SCROLL}其实我是个{NEWLINE}心地善良的野营男孩。

strings.zh: 你终于来了啊。{SCROLL}这是为你准备的！{NEWLINE}这是我送你的礼物,{CLEAR}你就别客气了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Yeah! Hey, here you are!{SCROLL}I’ve been holding on to this just for{NEWLINE}you. Don’t be shy--go ahead and{CLEAR}take it. It’s a present!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？难道你现在{NEWLINE}已经到我附近了？{SCROLL}要是就在旁边的话,{NEWLINE}就别跟我打电话了！
strings.en: Hm? Oh, you’re just around the corner?{SCROLL}If you’re that close, why bother with{NEWLINE}a phone call? Humph!

strings.zh: 虽说精灵是应该{NEWLINE}放在家中让你疼的,{SCROLL}不过我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}经常和我一起{CLEAR}出去野营,{CLEAR}它真是个精力旺盛的家伙啊！{SCROLL}对了,最近我一瞬间就把{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}给打败了！{CLEAR}真想让你也看看。
strings.en: People say Pokémon should be{NEWLINE}kept at home and pampered,{SCROLL}but my {VAR:0100:10} comes camping with me{NEWLINE}all the time. It’s got energy to burn!{SCROLL}Oh, and the other day we{NEWLINE}beat a {VAR:0100:11} in a flash!{CLEAR}I wish you could’ve seen it.

strings.zh: 要捕捉野生的精灵,{NEWLINE}单单提升自己的精灵{CLEAR}实力是远远不够的,{SCROLL}精灵球乱扔一通{NEWLINE}也同样无济于事。{SCROLL}重要的是自己和精灵{NEWLINE}之间的默契。{SCROLL}我和{VAR:0100:10}的配合{CLEAR}简直就是天衣无缝！{SCROLL}⋯⋯不过前几天{NEWLINE}我还是被{VAR:0100:11}{CLEAR}给逃掉了。{SCROLL}果然理论还是要{NEWLINE}结合实践啊。
strings.en: To catch wild Pokémon, just{NEWLINE}making your own Pokémon{CLEAR}stronger isn’t nearly enough.{SCROLL}And throwing Poké Balls around{NEWLINE}wildly won’t help either.{SCROLL}What matters is the bond{NEWLINE}between you and your Pokémon.{SCROLL}My {VAR:0100:10} and I{NEWLINE}are perfectly in sync!{SCROLL}...Even so, a {VAR:0100:11} got{NEWLINE}away from us the other day.{SCROLL}I guess theory only gets{NEWLINE}you so far without practice.

strings.zh: 前不久我遇到{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}了！{SCROLL}那时正好是我{NEWLINE}在从野营回来的路上,{CLEAR}吓了我一跳！{SCROLL}果然身处在大自然中,{NEWLINE}你就要无时无刻留意自己的周围！
strings.en: Hear me out! Earlier, we met a wild{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}It kind of jumped out as we were on the{NEWLINE}way home from a camping excursion!{CLEAR}I was so surprised!{SCROLL}I guess it goes to show you shouldn’t{NEWLINE}let your guard down when you’re out{CLEAR}in nature!

strings.zh: 我刚还在想{NEWLINE}是不是该去做饭了,{CLEAR}结果就想起你来了。{SCROLL}在吃饭前,{NEWLINE}我们再来一场对战怎么样？{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}带上你最得意的精灵来吧！
strings.en: I was getting ready to cook up some{NEWLINE}chow, and I started thinking about you.{SCROLL}Before I sit down to eat, would you like{NEWLINE}to battle again?{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}, so bring{NEWLINE}your best Pokémon!

strings.zh: 你怎么了？{NEWLINE}难道是迷路了？{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}的最中间,{CLEAR}你应该很快就能找的！
strings.en: Huh? What’s going on? Did you get lost{NEWLINE}or something?{SCROLL}Stay calm... I am right smack on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}, so you should{CLEAR}have no trouble finding me!

strings.zh: 你知道郊游和野营{NEWLINE}之间的区别吗？{SCROLL}区别在于⋯⋯歌曲！{SCROLL}郊游应该是{NEWLINE}唱着轻快的歌曲,{CLEAR}信步在山野间。{SCROLL}野营则应该是{NEWLINE}唱着哀愁,孤独的曲子,{CLEAR}然后注视那燃烧的火焰。{SCROLL}哎？{NEWLINE}你不信？{SCROLL}那下次有时间了,{NEWLINE}我们一起去野营,{CLEAR}我们两人盯着那火焰,{CLEAR}一起唱那首{CLEAR}哀伤的曲调！
strings.en: Do you know the difference between{NEWLINE}going on a picnic and camping?{SCROLL}It’s a song, of course!{SCROLL}When you’re going on a picnic, you sing a{NEWLINE}happy, upbeat little tune as you hike{CLEAR}over hills and fields.{SCROLL}When you’re camping, you sing quiet,{NEWLINE}mournful songs of grief and loss while{CLEAR}sitting and staring at the campfire.{SCROLL}What? You don’t believe me?{SCROLL}Then next time we’ve got the chance,{NEWLINE}let’s go camping together. The two of{CLEAR}us can stare into the flames and sing a{CLEAR}sad tune together!

strings.zh: 前几天我为了生火{NEWLINE}而在地上打洞时{CLEAR}发现了一个很珍贵的东西！{SCROLL}好像是什么太阳石。{SCROLL}我想把它送给你,{NEWLINE}地点就在{VAR:0104:3}！
strings.en: Recently, I was digging a fire pit in the{NEWLINE}ground so I could cook supper, and{CLEAR}I found an unusual item!{SCROLL}Apparently this thing is called a{NEWLINE}Sun Stone.{SCROLL}I’ll give it to you. I’m waiting on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 你怎么还没来拿太阳石啊！{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}快点来吧！
strings.en: I still have that Sun Stone I said I’d{NEWLINE}give you!{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}, so{NEWLINE}come and get it as soon as you can!
